title: Physics-informed distribution of relaxation times estimation and latent-space condition monitoring of solid oxide fuel and electrolysis cells from electrochemical impedance spectroscopy
abstract: arXiv:2608.13305v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Estimating the distribution of relaxation times (DRT) fromelectrochemical impedance spectroscopy (EIS) is an ill-posed inverse problem that is highly sensitive to regularisation choices. We propose a physics-informed convolutional autoencoder that estimates DRT directly from EIS data without spectrum-specific tuning. A discretised relation between impedance and the DRT is embedded in the training process, constraining the network to produce impedance-consistent distributions. The model resolves overlapping relaxation processes in synthetic two-ZARC spectra and accurately reconstructs measurements from three independent solid oxide fuel and electrolysis cell datasets, with range-normalised errors below 1.1%. Decoder-probe analysis shows that the learned latent representation is organised according to relaxation timescale. translated_title: 基于物理信息的弛豫时间分布估计及固体氧化物燃料电池和电解池电化学阻抗谱的潜在状态监测
translated_abstract: 从电化学阻抗谱（EIS）估计弛豫时间分布（DRT）是一个不适定的逆问题，对正则化选择高度敏感。我们提出了一种基于物理信息的卷积自编码器，可直接从EIS数据估计DRT，无需针对特定频谱进行调整。在训练过程中嵌入了阻抗与DRT之间的离散化关系，约束网络生成与阻抗一致的分布。该模型在合成双ZARC光谱中解析了重叠的弛豫过程，并准确重建了来自三个独立固体氧化物燃料电池和电解池数据集的测量结果，范围归一化误差低于1.1%。解码器探针分析表明，学习到的潜在表示按弛豫时间尺度进行组织。该潜在空间中的距离捕捉了操作变化、氢气短缺事件和长期退化。该模型为基于EIS的实时诊断提供了无监督工具，无需手动调参或标注。
tldr: 本文提出一种物理信息卷积自编码器，直接从EIS数据估计DRT并生成潜在空间，实现对固体氧化物电池的操作变化、氢气短缺和长期退化的无监督监测。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a physics-informed convolutional autoencoder that estimates DRT directly from EIS data and generates a latent space for unsupervised monitoring of operational changes, hydrogen shortages, and long-term degradation in solid oxide cells.
